description: Quality checklist for computer vision studies applied to movement disorders in neurodegenerative diseases.

questions.question: Is the sample size (n) reported?
questions.guidance: Look for explicit n= or participant count.

questions.question: Is the disease described with clear diagnostic criteria?
questions.guidance: Check for established criteria (e.g., SARA score for SCA).

questions.question: Is a control group included?
questions.guidance: Healthy controls or age-matched comparison group.

questions.question: Are demographics reported (age, sex)?
questions.guidance: At minimum mean age and sex distribution.

questions.question: Is the video capture setup described (camera, FPS, resolution)?
Is the full CV pipeline described (detection, tracking, features)?
questions.guidance: From raw video to final features used for classification.

questions.question: Is cross-validation or independent test set used?
questions.guidance: k-fold CV, LOSO, or separate test set.

questions.question: Is comparison with clinical gold standard performed?
questions.guidance: Correlation with SARA, UPDRS, or expert rating.

questions.question: Are statistical tests reported?
questions.guidance: p-values, confidence intervals, or effect sizes.

questions.question: Can results be replicated from the information given?
Is ethical approval declared?
questions.guidance: IRB, ethics committee, or informed consent.
